summary: Browse, search and connect the apps your workspace works with.
intent: Block: an app directory. A Connected filter chip over the IntegrationPicker catalogue (search, categories, one tile per app); a tile's Connect or Manage opens a Drawer with the app's detail, what it can access, and Connect or Disconnect.
useWhen: an Integrations or Apps area where people find, connect and disconnect apps
show which apps are connected and what each one can access
a connect flow that needs a detail step before the connection
doNotUseWhen: only the catalogue, connecting straight from the tile — IntegrationPicker
settings for one connected app — the integration-settings pattern

apps.note: IntegrationPicker items plus drawer detail: { id, name, description, category?, status: 'available'|'connected'|'comingSoon', icon?, publisher?, about?, permissions?: string[], connectedNote? }[]

note.note: Muted note on the catalogue, e.g. "example providers".

categories.note: Category order for the filter. Default: in order of appearance.

selectedId.note: Controlled: the app whose drawer is open, or null.

connectingId.note: That app's Connect reads Connecting… and is announced.

onRequest.note: Request an integration, when search or the directory finds nothing.

layout: head: h2 title and the connected count, with the Connected FilterButton at the end; wraps on narrow blocks
body: IntegrationPicker, whose tiles fill the row at 14rem or more (one column at 390)
detail: a right Drawer (md); on narrow screens the kit Drawer's own sizing applies

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
the Connected chip is a kit FilterButton toggle with aria-pressed, described by the connected count
search, category and tiles are IntegrationPicker's: a labelled Input, a SegmentedControl radio group, tile actions described by the app name
the detail is a kit Drawer (dialog, focus trap, Escape, focus returns to the tile action)
the drawer says the status in words (Badge), not colour alone; Connecting is announced in a status region
no motion of its own; the parts' motion is transform and opacity and off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not rebuild AppDirectory from a local grid of cards; import the block
Do not connect straight from a tile here; the tile opens the detail, the drawer connects
Do not use a real provider's logo or name without labelling it an example
Only one solid primary in the view: Connect in the open drawer
snippet: <AppDirectory note="example providers" apps={apps} onConnect={connect} onDisconnect={disconnect} connectingId={connecting} onRequest={request} />
